draft.title: Contrapositive and contradiction
card: The contrapositive of "if P then Q" is "if not Q then not P". The two statements are equivalent, so proving one proves the other. Use it when "not Q" is easier to work from.
Assume the statement is false. Reason step by step until you reach something impossible. Then the assumption was wrong, so the statement is true.
Split all possibilities into groups that cover every number, such as n even or n odd. Prove the statement in each group.
Claim: if n² is even, then n is even. Contrapositive: if n is odd, then n² is odd. Let n = 2k + 1. Then n² = 4k² + 4k + 1 = 2(2k² + 2k) + 1, which is odd. So the claim is true.
draft.remember: Contrapositive turns "if P then Q" into "if not Q then not P". Contradiction assumes the statement is false and finds an impossibility.

a.q: What is the contrapositive of "if n is divisible by 6, then n is even"?
opts: If n is not even, then n is not divisible by 6
If n is even, then n is divisible by 6
If n is not divisible by 6, then n is not even
If n is divisible by 6, then n is not even
a.why: The contrapositive swaps the two parts and negates both: if not Q then not P. Here that gives "if n is not even, then n is not divisible by 6". The option that only swaps the parts is the converse, which is not equivalent to the original.
a.clue: Swap the two parts, then negate both.

b.q: Dana wants to prove "if n² is odd, then n is odd". Which start gives a valid proof of this statement by contrapositive?
opts: Let n be even, so n = 2k, and show n² is even
Let n be odd, so n = 2k + 1, and show n² is odd
Let n² be odd, so n² = 2k + 1, and show n is odd
Let n be even, so n = 2k, and show n² is odd
b.why: The contrapositive is "if n is not odd, then n² is not odd", which means: if n is even, then n² is even. Starting with n = 2k leads to n² = 4k², which is even. Starting with n odd only proves the converse.
b.clue: Write "not Q then not P" first, using even in place of not odd.

a.best: If n is not even, then n is not divisible by 6

b.best: Let n be even, so n = 2k, and show n² is even
